description: Field validation rules (the Validation config tab): Field -> FieldValidation-owned Criteria -> Condition{Operator, RHSValue, ErrorMessage}. Extends the engine's F7 shape with three live corrections captured 2026-08-12 (#48, cell 1): the ErrorMessage key, multi-Criteria-per-field, and new operator strings incl. the relative-date literal "Today".
notes: ErrorMessage is a REAL per-Condition key the platform writes (human-readable failure text) — the engine's own graph.add_field_validation has no parameter for it: a capability gap to close in the engine.

A field can own MULTIPLE Criteria nodes (one per rule) — the platform's own builder does NOT append a second Condition into the first Criteria. This falsifies the engine docstring's 'one Criteria per field' as a description of platform behavior; the engine's additive reuse still works, it is just not what the platform itself does.

Wire-proven Operator strings: MAX_LENGTH, CONTAINS (already known) + GREATER_THAN (Number, RHSValue "0") + AFTER (Date, RHSValue "Today"). "Today" is a platform relative-date keyword — the SAME literal also works as a Field DefaultValue; read it, never guess its casing.
'Must not be empty' does NOT become a Condition — the platform flips the field's own Required:true instead. Route not-empty asks to Required.

Q&A-claimed but UNVERIFIED operator families (reply-only, no wire proof): MIN_LENGTH, EQUAL_TO/NOT_EQUAL_TO, NOT_CONTAINS, STARTS_WITH/ENDS_WITH, regex pattern, LESS_THAN, BETWEEN, BEFORE, Is Today/Future/Past. Each needs a live write before use.
Copilot structural builds AUTO-PUBLISH the draft (PublishedAt changes) without being asked — snapshot accordingly.
